notes: items: list order is the drop order (the camera first); label = the checklist, caption = shown with the number while the item falls; hull = convex hull of the opaque pixels in pixel-edge coordinates relative to the sprite top-left.

Sprites are faithful conversions of the ChatGPT sources; light, gimbal, tripod and mic re-exported with a coarser cell on 23.10 (kit v6) so the whole kit packs inside the box; meant for 2 CSS px per art px on desktop, 1 on phones.
Light comes from the upper right on the box (REVERSE.md B4); the icons keep the lighting of their sources.
fileDark: the same sprite with a lighter 1 px silhouette (#5a5e66, navy #34507a for the iPhone) for the dark theme #151719; same size and hull.
Kit v8: the box is bottomless (box.swallow); the box layers are made by tools/icons/build_void.py.
artPx: all sizes and coordinates are in art pixels (1 art px = 1 PNG px)

anchor.note: where the box touches the ground: just below its bottom vertex (the 4 px run at x-2..x+1); same for every layer

floor.note: the box interior in the vertical plane through the left and right corners: inner walls at x and x+w, rim at y, floor surface at y+h. Pixel-edge coordinates.

box.frontRimNote: top edge of the front walls (V shape: left corner, front vertex, right corner). Item pixels below this line are hidden by the front layer.

opening.note: the top rhombus of the box (2:1, 4 px flat runs at the top and bottom vertices)

lid.note: frame 0 = open box, last frame = closed box; per frame draw back, items, front; hide items from the last frame on

closedBox.note: opaque area of closed.png (for the burst into pixels)

box.tapeNote: tape.png overlays closed.png at the same origin (light-grey cross with the SALUT spark repeated)
box.shadowNote: shadow.png is a flat silhouette meant to be tinted with the theme shadow colour
box.swallowNote: bottomless box (kit v8): every item drops through the opening and is swallowed by the void; nothing rests inside (js/kit-physics.js, js/kit-draw.js).
